_readme: Rename this file to .claude/settings.json in this repo.
Claude cannot write it itself: .claude/ is a protected path, and in auto mode
protected-path writes go to the classifier even when an allow rule matches.
Every rule here is deliberately NARROW. Auto mode DROPS broad rules on entry:
blanket Bash(*), wildcarded interpreters like Bash(python*), and package-manager
run commands such as Bash(npm:*). Those would be silently discarded.
defaultMode is intentionally absent: cloud sessions ignore bypassPermissions
and dontAsk from settings files, and Auto is already the highest mode they offer.
